body.x: CES 2025, the world’s largest tech exhibition, concluded successfully. It spotlighted the latest advancements from global innovators. Korea’s Pangyo Techno Valley once again cemented its presence on the worldwide stage. Pangyo-based startups, leading in IT and BT, showcased cutting-edge technologies in AI, smart healthcare, and eco-friendly solutions, captivating attendees and investors alike.

With its unique strengths, Pangyo exemplifies the successful collaboration between government and private sectors in fostering an innovative ecosystem. This report delves into the standout technologies from CES 2025, highlighting the competitive edge of Pangyo-based companies as they establish themselves as a hub for future innovation.
‘DUWING’: EhanCreative's Vision for Global EdTech Leadership

EhanCreative (CEO Hyeran Jeon) has garnered recognition for its technological excellence, being selected for the 2024 TIPS R&D program and the "Super-Gap Startup 1000+ AI sector.” The company has also solidified its reputation by receiving the WIN-WIN HONORS award and the Ministry of Science and ICT Minister's Award in 2024. Through partnerships with domestic institutions and global collaborators, EhanCreative continues to expand its operational scope.

The company provides educational programs to institutions and corporations in Korea and abroad while extending its reach into industrial sectors. Among its offerings, the DUWING platform stands out as an interactive educational content platform that enables students to create 3D objects, collaborate in real-time, and learn at their own pace. Leveraging AI-driven solutions, the platform offers tailored educational experiences and develops space-based programs that utilize unused classroom spaces.

The platform also integrates generative AI tools for creation and collaboration, supporting automatic content generation, group collaboration, and personalized dashboards. With these innovations, EhanCreative aims to redefine future educational environments by providing holistic solutions.

By participating in CES 2025, EhanCreative seeks to expand its global presence, attract new customers, and position itself as a leader in the EdTech sector. CEO Hyeran Jeon emphasized, “CES is a pivotal platform to showcase our technology and explore collaborations with global partners. Through AI, we are committed to transforming the future of education.”

As a pioneer in AI-based EdTech solutions, EhanCreative is setting a new paradigm in education with its innovative technologies. Since its establishment, the company has consistently engaged in research and development while fostering collaborations to strengthen its foothold in the global market.

Pangyo Techno Valley is a global integrated R&D hub focused on IT, BT, CT, and NT, integrating Research (R), People (P), Information (I), and Trade (T). As Gyeonggi-do’s representative innovation cluster, Pangyo Techno Valley was established to secure national new growth drivers such as technological innovation, human resource development, job creation, and enhancing international business competitiveness. As of 2023, 1,666 companies employ 78,751 people, and it has positioned itself as the most innovative hub in South Korea, with sales amounting to 167.7 trillion KRW (125.5 billion USD).

Furthermore, the Techno Valley Innovation Division of the Gyeonggi-do Business & Science Accelerator (GBSA) holds monthly events such as the Pangyo Evening Meet-Up, Pan-Pan Day, and the Pangyo Startup Investment Exchange “In-Best Pangyo” to maximize the value of Pangyo Techno Valley. They also support the Pangyo Overseas Promotion Program, which publicizes information about Pangyo’s companies, products, and services to domestic and foreign investors and the media, thereby facilitating foreign investment.
